pppoe_user.description: The DSL username provided by the ISP.

pppoe_iface.description: The network interface used for the PPPoE connection.

pppoe_timeout.description: The timeout value for the pppoe program (-T option).

pppoe_mtu.description: The MTU size for the standard pppoe configuration (-m option).

pppoe_mtu_conservative.description: The conservative MTU size for fallback configurations (-m option).

pppoe_idle_timeout.description: Idle time in seconds before disconnecting when demand-dialing is used.

pppoe_lcp_interval.description: Interval in seconds between LCP echo requests.

pppoe_lcp_failure.description: Number of missed LCP echo requests before considering the connection down.
